_extraction_flags.notes: Excellent O-ISAC paper! Retroreflective sensing using CCR (Corner Cube Reflector) for passive ranging.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: RO-ISAC system with 4 transceivers on ceiling and CCR at receiver. Fig.3: 5×5×3m room simulation. Fig.4: BER vs SNR for QAM orders. Fig.5-6: Distance RMSE vs symbols/SNR. Fig.7-8: Spatial positioning RMSE distribution.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Retroreflective Optical ISAC (RO-ISAC). Uses OFDM for both communication and ranging. Sensing: Cross-correlation of transmitted and reflected signals (via CCR) to estimate ToA. Communication: OFDM with MRC diversity from 4 LEDs. IM/DD system design.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 2/4/8/16-QAM OFDM. BER ~1e-7 at SNR ~106-116 dB. Sensing: Range resolution 1 cm (derived from 15 GSa/s ADC). Distance RMSE < 1 cm with 16+ symbols. Positioning RMSE ~3.5 cm with proper height diversity.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Passive ranging via CCR (user side requires no complex hardware). Transceiver-integrated design (LED+PD co-located). Diversity gain from 4 transceivers for both comm and positioning. Gap: Simulation only, no experimental validation.

bibliographic.title: Retroreflective Optical ISAC Supporting 3D Positioning in Indoor Environments
bibliographic.authors: Haochuan Wang, Binbin Zhu, Zhihong Zeng, Sihua Shao, Chen Chen, Min Liu

application.scenario_description: Indoor 3D positioning and communication using 4 LED/PD transceivers and a corner cube reflector (CCR) at the receiver.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Retroreflective Optical ISAC using CCR for passive ranging. Transceiver-integrated design enables simultaneous communication and 3D positioning without affecting user experience.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Positioning accuracy degradation in RF ISAC (meter-level) compared to optical (cm-level).

transmitter.notes: 4 LED/PD transceivers on ceiling. Each LED has co-located PD for sensing. DAC at 5 GSa/s.

receiver.notes: Receiver has PD for communication + CCR for passive reflection. ADC at 15 GSa/s.

integration.notes: Transceiver-integrated design: same LED/PD pair for TX and sensing RX.

waveform.notes: Same OFDM signal used for both communication and ranging. IFFT/FFT size 256, 64 data subcarriers.

channel_wireless.notes: Room 5×5×3m. Receiver at z=1m, transceivers at z~3m. LoS only.

comm_metrics.notes: BER ~1e-7 at SNR 106-116 dB depending on modulation order (2/4/8/16-QAM).

sensing_metrics.notes: Range resolution = c*Ts/2 = 1 cm. Positioning RMSE 3.5 cm with height diversity. Cross-correlation based ToA.

tradeoff.notes: Modulation order does not affect ranging accuracy. Passive sensing does not degrade communication.
